title: Frequently Asked Questions
subtitle: Find answers to common questions about GeoAnalyzer

general.a: GeoAnalyzer is a tool for analyzing the quality of life in different city districts. We collect data on safety, environment, transport, and infrastructure to help you choose the perfect place to live.
We currently support major cities in Ukraine and Poland. We are continuously working to expand our geographic coverage.

subscription.q: What is the difference between Premium and the free version?
subscription.a: Premium provides access to advanced filters, detailed statistics for each criterion, district comparison, and the ability to save an unlimited number of favorite places.

subscription.q: How do I cancel my subscription?
subscription.a: You can cancel your subscription at any time in your Profile under the 'Payment History' section. Access to Premium features will remain until the end of the paid period.

data.q: Where do you get the data from?
data.a: We aggregate information from open government registers, Google Maps API, environmental monitoring stations, and user reviews.

data.q: How often is the information updated?
data.a: Real estate price and environmental data are updated weekly. Infrastructure data is verified once a month.

account.q: How do I change my password?
account.a: Go to Profile -> Change Password. You will need to enter your new password twice for confirmation.
